model.name: BUG10: Collection detail BLANK in room context — tap Members/Files → blank drawer.
model.description: BUG: in the ROOM tree (not just /trace), tapping a collection node (Members or Files) opens the drawer but renders BLANK. Same family as BUG8 (synthetic-UUID collection not a real unit → fetch 404) but reproduces in the ROOM surface. FIX scope must cover BOTH surfaces (/trace + room). The collection detail resolver must detect synthetic UUIDs and fetch children from the parent Room regardless of which surface triggers it.
